mentions.name: Branching story-writing website
mentions.description: A website for writing a story one block at a time, where writers can branch the narrative off wherever they want to take it. A revived side project, also used as an excuse to experiment with Claude and explore ideas.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a website for writing a story one block at a time, branching off wherever you feel like you'd want to move the story.
mentions.author: syldarion
